summary: ```markdown # CLO Skills Workshop - CLO x Blender Collaboration Process ## Introduction Hello everyone, welcome to my channel. Today, I will introduce the link between CLO and Blender. This is the project file. ## Recording Animation Here, you need to record the animation in advance. After recording, play and check. You will need to delete the animation because Blender can't directly identify multiple layers of animation. ## UV Rendering The setting starts at 30. Now we need to do UV rendering. Click on the UV rendering icon. Click on Vithub. ### Video Editor Setup In this case, we choose the Video Editor. Click on Video Editor and spices which is left. Here, we set up the re-turb. It does the work. Click on Edit, adapt including text, and click on Next. Add a new text layer. ## Model Preparation In the next step, we will do a close-up of the model. The model will be in FBX format. Note that the FBX location cannot have Chinese characters. Then select the virtual model and select all. Here, select a single target. If you select multiple targets, it will not contain animation. ### UV Coordinates Select the unified UV coordinates. In the options, select the model action and save the animation. The ratio here is selected because the unit of Blender is rice. Click OK for other default settings and click OK to confirm. ## Exporting Animation Next, export the animation of the costume. The costume is exported to Alembic format. Alembic has two formats; here, select Ogawa format. You can find Owlaye. Click OK to confirm. Here, select OCC format. That's all, and for the location screen, there is no selection needed. ### Location Screen Settings Click OK, then select the location screen format to Open Cube Até Showhow. The default is the time interval between the two data samples. For example, if the default is 2 hours, each two-time units, such as seconds, store one data. The relative sample value of the needle is the time value, whether it is based on the needle number and not the absolute time, such as seconds. ## Blender Import Process The unit selects the rice and selects the play area along with the relative sample value of the needle. Next, open Blender and press A to select and delete. First, import the model by clicking the file and selecting import FBX. Here, you can see that the model has been imported. ### Adjusting Animation Here, you need to adjust the animation to be changed to 0. Then import the costume by also clicking the file to import Alembic. Here you need to hide Google. Next, play the animation to see if there is a problem. ### Variables and Animation Here you need to hide all variables. If there is an option for more formulas, show them. You can also expand the animation here. In this way, when the animation is object, the color name changes. ## Material and Texture Application Next, change the material to check the effect. You need to apply the texture to the clothing application, switching to the color mode. Here, you need to use the node rango plugin. In the edit tab, set the plugin, search for the node plugin. ## Using the Node Plugin After selecting, you can use it. Click on the new key, click on the principle, BSDF. Then press CTRL plus SHIFT plus T to find the previously saved UV image and configure it. Here, you can adjust the brightness of the face. ## Scene and Lighting Setup Next, you can make the scene and the lighting. Here, you can make the scene and the lighting. And finally, the road—just click on the light now. ## Camera Adjustments If you have any questions, leave what you thought in the comment box. Press Shift A to increase the camera. Press the float button to enter the camera view. If you want to adjust the camera view, press and hold the camera view. Select the camera and go to the view. ### Final Adjustments Finally, adjust the camera to the view. Adjust to the rendering mode to check the effect. You can see that it is black now because there is no light source. Here, I used HDR as the light source. It is also possible to use HDR as the light source. ## Environment Texture Setup Switch to the color change to the world environment. In the blank, right-click to increase the texture environment texture. Open your HDR picture on the application and connect the color. Switch to the rendering mode to check the rendering effect. ## Final Rendering Finally, set the rendering attribute and perform the final rendering. You can see the final result. ## Conclusion Thank you for watching. Thank you. ```
